transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you know, I'm reviewing the operating charter for our weekly cross-team planning forum. Several participants have raised concerns that the current open-discussion format makes it difficult to raise issues, and we also don't have a consistent advance-notice standard or a designated neutral facilitator. Before I finalize any revised format, I want to check in with each regular participant and the meeting coordinator to get your input. I'd like to hear what's working, what isn't, and what changes you think would help. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Leah. I appreciate you checking in with each of us before finalizing anything. From my perspective, the lack of a consistent advance-notice standard is a real issue — having the agenda shared ahead of time would make it much easier to prepare and participate meaningfully. I also think having a designated neutral facilitator would help create a more structured environment where people feel comfortable raising concerns. I do have some specific requirements related to advance notice and how discussions are run that I'd like to share with you.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Leah, and thanks Taylor — I agree on both points. As meeting coordinator, I can share that the current open-discussion format has led to some real issues with people being heard. In fact, I've documented multiple occasions in the last month where participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns. I also have something to share regarding facilitation arrangements that I think is relevant to this discussion.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both — this is really helpful input. Taylor, I'd definitely like to hear your specific requirements around advance notice and discussion format, so please go ahead and share those. And Morgan, the documented interruptions you mentioned are exactly the kind of concrete evidence I need to make the case for a more structured format. Please share what you've documented and your thoughts on facilitation arrangements. I want to make sure I have everyone's input before I finalize anything, so let's keep going around the group.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should share my specific requirements now. My approved workplace arrangement requires the planning agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and it prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I haven't raised these with you before because the arrangement is usually handled through my direct manager, but since you're asking each of us directly for input on the charter, I want to make sure these conditions are reflected in the revised format.
transcript.speaker: A2
